answer: Locks are recorded in voyage, expire in hollow, and forge lists each expiry. An farming party running 11 aliases therefore needs 85 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1623 identities would post 1735 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
